project_type: React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript SPA with dark spatial glassmorphism design
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build and confirm zero TypeScript errors and successful Vite bundle output
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node 22. pnpm package manager.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, all components match dark spatial glassmorphism design, lazy-loaded routes
key_patterns: Hooks in src/hooks/ using @tanstack/react-query + supabase client. Services in src/services/ grouped by domain. UI components in src/components/ui/ (shadcn pattern). Shared components in src/components/shared/. Layout in src/components/layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, TopNav). Pages in src/pages/ by domain. Contexts in src/contexts/. Types in src/types/. Design tokens in src/index.css. Motion from 'motion/react'. All routes lazy-loaded in App.tsx.
directory_structure: Root: Vite config, Dockerfile, netlify.toml. src/: App.tsx (routes), main.tsx (providers), index.css (design tokens). src/components/: ui/ (20 shadcn components), layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, TopNav, Breadcrumbs), shared/ (DataTable, KPICard, CommandPalette, etc.), ai/ (FloatingAIWidget). src/pages/: auth/, inventory/, crm/, procurement/, sales/, reports/, ai/, settings/. src/hooks/: 30+ data hooks. src/services/: inventory/, crm/, sales/, ai/, excel/. src/contexts/: AuthContext, SidebarContext. supabase/migrations/: 001-007. public/: favicon.svg, icons.svg.
